info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Weather Alerts Regions-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Regions API enables users to retrieve a list of regions that are currently affected by weather alerts. This API serves as a key resource for developers needing to integrate real-time weather information into their applications, facilitating timely responses to severe weather conditions. Typical consumers include emergency services, weather platforms, and applications focused on public safety. By providing detailed and updated information on affected regions, this API enhances situational awareness and supports proactive decision-making during adverse weather events.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all alerts associated with a particular region. It is designed to help users stay informed about critical notifications and updates relevant to their geographical area.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve alert information based on the specified region. Ensure that the payload adheres to the required schema format to successfully receive the alerts related to the region.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested alerts for the specified region.
